title: 高三多题听力：花园与声学试验
instruction: 听四段较长对话和一段独白，五组分别回答2、3、3、4、3题，共15题，每题三选。每段听两遍；听前每题5秒读题，听后每题5秒作答，已含在音轨中。来源题面/印本附注脚本/参考键可核，原音轨未取得；本稿提供完整原创音频与脚本。
source_form_notice: 高三公开阶段卷第二节五材料2/3/3/4/3、三选、两遍结构已核；附印本注释脚本及参考键，原录音缺、原校及地域学期未认证，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套供审阅。
teacher_source_notice: 公开标签为雅礼相关阶段卷，正文只确认高三英语，地域与学期未在正文确认，学校原版未认证。原题面、附注印本脚本与参考键在库；脚本为带题号/词汇注释的OCR文本，未认证清洁逐字/独立听校，原音轨未取得，源全输入未通过，不当gold。
source_scoring_notice: 来源本节15题、每题1.5分、满分22.5分为明确印出配置，非年级统一标准。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The garden talk was advertised for the hall. Why are we meeting in the greenhouse?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The hall is available, but the speaker wants to show the plants as she discusses them. Pictures would not let us compare the leaves ourselves.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Will everyone be able to hear her?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: She has asked us to split into two small groups. One group will listen while the other examines the labelled trays, then we will swap.

options: The speaker wants people to examine real plants.
The greenhouse has a larger stage.
questions.rationale: 现场比较叶片不能由图片替代；A厅可用，C未提舞台。

questions.stem: How will the visitors be organised?
options: Into two groups that exchange activities.
Into one silent group for the whole visit.
Into groups based on their plant collections.
questions.rationale: 一组听一组看托盘后互换；B/C不符。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your room sounds different today. Have you bought a new speaker?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. I hung those thick curtains to reduce the echo. I am recording a spoken history project, so clear speech matters more than powerful music.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The curtains seem to help. How will you know how much difference they make?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I recorded the same passage from the same chair before hanging them. I will compare it with a new recording using the same microphone settings.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then do not move the rug until you have finished. Otherwise you will have changed two things at once.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good point. I will leave everything else where it was.

questions.stem: Why did the man hang curtains?
options: To reduce echo in speech recordings.
questions.rationale: 说clear speech和reduce echo；A无装饰目的，B非强音乐。

options: The same passage recorded before and after.
Two microphones used in different rooms.
questions.rationale: 同椅同段同麦设置前后比较；B/C引入改变。

questions.stem: Why should the rug stay in place?
options: Moving it would introduce another change.
It belongs to the history teacher.
questions.rationale: 避免同时改变两个因素；A/C无据。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have ordered fifty copies of the walking guide. If people like them, we can print more.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Are the opening times final? The mill closes on Mondays now, and your file still says it opens every day.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I checked the tourism page last month.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The mill's own notice was updated yesterday. We should use that, and put a checked-on date in the guide.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The printer has not started yet. I will stop the order and change the file.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Ask them to send a digital proof after the change. We can check that version rather than assume the correction carried through.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: And I will put the guide online so we can update it between printings.

questions.stem: What error does the woman find?
options: The guide shows outdated opening times.
The guide names the wrong river.
The print order is for five hundred copies.
questions.rationale: 旧档每日开，现周一关；B无，C50非500。

questions.stem: Which information source does she prefer?
options: A visitor's memory of last summer.
questions.rationale: 优先场所昨天更新的通告；A旧且非直属，B未说。

questions.stem: What should be checked before printing?
options: Whether every copy has already been sold.
questions.rationale: 修改后索要digital proof核实改动落实；A/C非此核查。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You looked disappointed when the robot stopped at the edge of the mat.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It completed the route yesterday. Today I thought it had forgotten the program.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Was anything else different?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The mat was closer to the window. The code was unchanged.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then we should test the light before rewriting the code. The sensor might respond differently in direct sun.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Should we cover the window and run the same route?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, then uncover it and repeat the run. Record each result, including failures. One successful run will not settle the question.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: If the pattern supports the light explanation, could we add a cover over the sensor?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That might help, but test that separately. A cover may also block what the sensor is meant to detect.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: So we need to find a balance rather than just make the sensor darker.

options: The program appeared to have stopped working.
The robot had lost a wheel.
The mat had been removed completely.
questions.rationale: 昨天可完成今天停，以为程序失效；B/C无。
唯一环境变项移近窗；A/C未说。

questions.stem: What does the woman recommend first?
options: Compare repeated runs with different light.
questions.rationale: 先遮窗/开窗重复记录，非先改代码/电机。

questions.stem: Why should a sensor cover be tested separately?
options: It may also block useful detection.
It is forbidden in the competition.
It will automatically solve every failure.
questions.rationale: 罩也可能挡正常感测需另测；B/C未证。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text:
Our community repair afternoon is moving to the library next month. This is a change of venue, not a change in what volunteers can promise. They will examine an item and explain what they can attempt. They cannot guarantee that every item will work again, and some repairs require equipment that we do not have.

Please bring any removable parts and the instruction booklet if you still have it. A clear description of the fault is often more useful than saying that an item is simply broken. Tell the volunteer what happened just before it stopped working and whether the problem occurs every time.

There will be a demonstration table where visitors can watch a volunteer work on a practice item. You may ask questions there, but do not copy a procedure on an electrical item at home merely because it looked simple. The demonstration is meant to show how a problem is investigated, not to certify visitors to carry out repairs. We hope people leave with a better understanding of their belongings, whether or not a repair is possible that day.

questions.stem: What does the move to the library change?
questions.rationale: 仅换地点；B明确不能保证，C不认证。

options: The price of every item in their home.
Details of when and how the fault occurs.
A complete repair plan before arriving.
questions.rationale: 讲故障前发生什么、是否每次出现；A/C无要求。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the demonstration?
options: To promise same-day repairs for everyone.
To show how a fault is investigated.
questions.rationale: 明确观察排查过程，不授资格或保证当日修复；A/B相反。
